required_pr_review.summary: Pullfrog is the sole required exact-head AI review source.
required_pr_review.fallback_summary: Self-managed, Mergeguez, and CodeRabbit review evidence cannot replace exact-head Pullfrog review.

local_validation.summary: All available local gates pass for the repaired repository-owned auto-merge gate, which now accepts any valid base except main or master: 146 GitHub helper tests, 59 focused auto-merge/coordinator/workflow-policy tests, 29 checksum-verified actionlint and workflow-policy tests, Python compilation, coordinator-to-consumer schema compatibility, eligible non-stable-base and stable-base-rejection coverage, a real exact-old-OID receive-pack race, deterministic workflow materialization, canonical/live byte identity, JSON parsing, public-safety and secret-pattern scans, and whitespace checks. The local Speculoos binary is unavailable, so independent hosted Speculoos evidence remains required after publication.

github_checks.summary: PR #95 remains open at hosted head 10766f48799c527d5adf264b9c3ec09f4ef17c4f. The exact-head Pullfrog run succeeded but pullfrog-approval failed on one P1 receipt-shape finding and one P2 stale-base push finding; both are repaired locally and require guarded publication plus fresh exact-head hosted checks.

pullfrog_review.summary: Pullfrog review 5678056245 found that the consumer expected list-valued Pullfrog records although the coordinator emits singleton dictionaries, and that a normal porcelain push could accept a newer remote tip already reachable from the merge commit. The local repair consumes the producer's exact schema and submits a normal fast-forward Git receive-pack command whose old OID is the exact reviewed base SHA, so the server rejects any intervening base change in the same transaction. Fresh hosted Pullfrog review and approval remain required.

speculoos_evidence.summary: Independent hosted Speculoos evidence is required on the new exact head and cannot be replaced by Pullfrog output.

self_managed.summary: Not accepted as normal or fallback review evidence.

mergeguez_review.summary: Mergeguez is not a reviewer. It remains the manual publication and merge broker; automatic feature-to-dev merge is owned separately by the repository exact-head GitHub Actions gate, while stable-branch merge stays human-authorized.
